app_description: GPMD is a dual-builder platform. The Form Builder creates projects and collects structured input data through forms. The Dashboard Builder generates visualizations from that data. Both use phone number + OTP authentication.

form_builder.purpose: Create projects and collect structured form data

dashboard_builder.purpose: Visualize Form Builder data as charts and KPI cards

login_flow.form_builder: Open https://stage-gpmd-formbuilderui.theproindia.com/ → Wait until phone number field is visible → Enter phone number +91 9876543210 → Click Send OTP button → Enter OTP 123456 in OTP field → Click Verify OTP button → Dashboard loads with Form Builder and Dashboard Builder in left sidebar
login_flow.dashboard_builder: Open https://stage-gpmd-dashboardui.theproindia.com/ → Wait until phone number field is visible → Enter phone number +91 9876543210 → Click Send OTP button → Enter OTP 123456 in OTP field → Click Verify OTP button → Dashboard loads with Form Builder and Dashboard Builder in left sidebar

authentication.method: Phone number + OTP — NO email, NO password
authentication.flow: Enter phone number → Click Send OTP → Enter 6-digit OTP → Click Verify OTP → Access granted

navigation.form_builder_login: Open https://stage-gpmd-formbuilderui.theproindia.com/ → Enter +91 9876543210 → Click Send OTP → Enter 123456 → Click Verify OTP → Dashboard loads
navigation.dashboard_builder_login: Open https://stage-gpmd-dashboardui.theproindia.com/ → Enter +91 9876543210 → Click Send OTP → Enter 123456 → Click Verify OTP → Dashboard loads
navigation.open_form_builder: After login → Click Form Builder in left sidebar navigation
navigation.create_project: Form Builder → Click New Project button → Enter project name → Click Create button
navigation.open_project: Form Builder → Click project name in projects list
navigation.add_form_field: Open project → Click + Add Field button → Select field type → Configure label and validations → Click Save
navigation.publish_form: Open project → Click Publish button → Confirm in dialog → Form status changes to Published
navigation.view_submissions: Open project → Click Submissions tab → View all submitted form entries
navigation.open_dashboard_builder: After login → Click Dashboard Builder in left sidebar navigation
navigation.create_dashboard: Dashboard Builder → Click New Dashboard button → Enter dashboard name → Select source project → Click Create
navigation.add_chart_widget: Open dashboard → Click + Add Widget button → Select chart type → Configure X-axis and Y-axis → Click Save
navigation.logout: Click user profile icon top right → Click Logout

key_fields.publish_button: Button labelled 'Publish' — makes form live to accept submissions
key_fields.new_dashboard_button: Button labelled 'New Dashboard' in Dashboard Builder
key_fields.source_project_dropdown: Dropdown to select which Form Builder project to visualize
key_fields.add_widget_button: Button labelled '+ Add Widget' inside dashboard editor
key_fields.chart_type_selector: Chart types: Bar Chart, Line Chart, Pie Chart, Stacked Bar Chart, KPI Card
key_fields.x_axis_dropdown: Dropdown to select X-axis field from form submission data
key_fields.y_axis_dropdown: Dropdown to select Y-axis numeric field from form submission data

known_issues: OTP SMS delivery may be delayed up to 60 seconds on some network carriers
Resend OTP button sometimes requires page scroll to become visible on mobile
Dashboard charts may show stale data if browser cache is not cleared after new submissions
Session token expiry silently redirects to login — no visible notification shown
tech_stack: React 18 frontend, Azure Static Web Apps (CDN), REST API on Azure Functions, Phone OTP via SMS gateway (Twilio or MSG91), JWT-based authentication, Azure DevOps for ALM and CI/CD
extra_context: GPMD is a no-code B2B SaaS platform. Form Builder is always the entry point — create projects and forms here first. Dashboard Builder only works if a Form Builder project exists with submissions. Login is EXCLUSIVELY phone number + OTP — no email, no password, no Google login. Test phone: +91 9876543210 | OTP: 123456. Use Indian mobile format (+91 XXXXXXXXXX). Both builders share the same left sidebar navigation after login.
